editorial:
Picture a world where elite soldiers use high-tech gear to stop a shadowy arms dealer from destroying everything. That is the wild ride you get with this action-packed adventure. You follow Duke and Ripcord as they join the G.I. Joe team, a secret group of top fighters from around the globe. They face off against Destro and the mysterious Cobra organization, who want to plunge the world into chaos. The story jumps from the Egyptian desert to deep under the polar ice caps, giving you a globe-trotting feel. The vibe is pure popcorn fun, with big explosions, cool gadgets, and a team of heroes you can root for. It never takes itself too seriously, which makes it easy to sit back and enjoy.

The action scenes are loud and fast, with plenty of chases and fights to keep you entertained. The cast brings energy, especially the villains who chew the scenery in the best way. On the downside, the plot can feel thin and some effects look dated now. Still, if you want a brain-off thrill ride, this delivers. It is great for action fans and anyone who grew up with the toys. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the Joe team storms Cobra's underwater base near the polar ice caps. Duke confronts the Baroness and learns she was brainwashed by Cobra. Destro is captured and put in a metal mask. The Baroness is freed from mind control and joins the Joes. Cobra Commander escapes and vows revenge. The team saves the world from the nanomite warheads, and the movie ends with a tease of more battles to come.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big explosions and team-based action movies.
